source_refs.note: I. Screening and Sedimentation: a main subheading of 33.6 Wastewater Treatment, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 256-256.

blocks.text: Safai ka pehla stage (qadam) aam taur par screening aur sedimentation hai. Pani ko metal screens (dhaat ki jaaliyon) se guzaar kar bare insoluble (na ghulne wale) particles hata diye jate hain. Phir sedimentation hoti hai: pani ko bare tankon mein rok kar rakha jata hai taake us mein tairte suspended solids (tairte hue solid particles) gravity (zameen ki kashish) se neeche tah mein baith jayein.
